title: platform-objects: ten system objects declare `titleFormat` and no pointer, so the registry stamps `nameField: id` and a renderer honouring the declared pointer shows the raw record id as the title — the engine half of #20044
body:
Filed by the triage seat (#6015, `session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`) as the `domain:engine` half of #20044, split by where the fix lands. #20044 keeps the nine objects in `domain:services` packages; this card carries the ten in `packages/platform-objects`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The defect

Read on `origin/main` `2274894cc4` by the triage seat; the designation measurement is the #20015 dev's (PR #20042), relayed on #20044.

- Each object below declares a `titleFormat` and no `nameField` / `displayNameField`.
- At the registry's materialization seam (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, `provisionPrimary(…, { synthesize: false })`), the designate-only pass derives the first title-eligible field, which on these objects is `id`, and stamps `nameField: 'id'`. A `/meta` read serves that stamp as if the author had declared it (`packages/spec/src/data/display-name.ts`, the provenance note beside `objectTitleCompleteness`).
- objectui#9436 (ruling C1: a declared `nameField` outranks `titleFormat`) has landed on objectui `main` as PR objectui#10358. Once the console's objectui pin moves past it, the record page draws the raw id as the H1 of each object below. This is the regression #20015 fixed for five other objects (PR #20042, landed `7e6ca1787a`).

The ten objects, all in `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/` (the triage seat confirmed `titleFormat` present and no `nameField` in each file):

`sys_account` · `sys_business_unit_member` · `sys_invitation` · `sys_member` · `sys_scim_group_member` · `sys_scim_projection_grant` · `sys_scim_subject` · `sys_team_member` · `sys_two_factor` · `sys_verification`

## Remedy (reading 1 of #20044, in-contract)

- Follow the `titleFormat` describe's own migration instruction (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`): a single-field title moves to `nameField`; a composite becomes a text formula field designated as `nameField`.
- Use the shape of PR #20042: the formula reproduces today's `titleFormat` output, and the generated object translations are regenerated with the repo's tooling, not by hand.
- Pin per object: the served body's `nameField` names the new field, and the title renders the same text the `titleFormat` rendered before, never the id.

## Not this card

The class-level alternative (reading 2 of #20044: the designation pass does not stamp a derived pointer on an object that declares `titleFormat`) changes what every served body presents, customer objects included. The triage seat has put it to the maintainer as a contract decision. ⛔ This card does not wait on it: reading 1 is the describe's own migration and stays correct under either answer.

## Dedupe

One semantic issue search, open and closed, 「platform-objects system objects titleFormat no nameField designated id raw record id title formula nameField」: 4 hits. #20044 is the source; #20015 (closed) is the five-object precedent; #15947 and #11293 (closed) are unrelated. No card carries these ten objects.
